intent: register a new book with unique ISBN, title, and author
benefit: the library catalog is updated with accurate book information

scenarios.given: a librarian is authenticated and the ISBN does not already exist in the catalog
scenarios.when: the librarian submits valid book details with a non-empty title and author
scenarios.then: the system creates the book record and returns HTTP 201 with the generated book ID

scenarios.given: a librarian is authenticated and the ISBN does not already exist
scenarios.when: the librarian submits book details with an empty title
scenarios.then: the system returns HTTP 400 with a validation error indicating title must not be blank

scenarios.given: a book with a specific ISBN already exists in the catalog
scenarios.when: the librarian attempts to register another book with the same ISBN
scenarios.then: the system returns HTTP 409 Conflict with an error indicating ISBN must be unique

intent: update an existing book's title and author
benefit: the catalog remains accurate and up to date

scenarios.given: a book with a known ID exists in the catalog
scenarios.when: the librarian submits a new non-empty title and author for that book
scenarios.then: the system updates the book record and returns HTTP 200 with the updated book details

scenarios.given: no book exists with the provided ID
scenarios.when: the librarian attempts to update the book
scenarios.then: the system returns HTTP 404 Not Found

scenarios.given: a book with a known ID exists in the catalog
scenarios.when: the librarian submits an empty title
scenarios.then: the system returns HTTP 400 with a validation error indicating title must not be blank

benefit: I can check whether a book exists and view its title and author

scenarios.given: a book with a specific ISBN exists in the catalog
scenarios.when: the patron requests the book by that ISBN
scenarios.then: the system returns HTTP 200 with the book's title, author, and ISBN

scenarios.given: no book exists with the provided ISBN
scenarios.when: the patron requests the book by that ISBN
scenarios.then: the system returns HTTP 404 Not Found

benefit: I can remove outdated or damaged books from the catalog

scenarios.given: a book with a known ID exists in the catalog
scenarios.when: the librarian requests deletion of that book
scenarios.then: the system deletes the book record and returns HTTP 204 No Content

scenarios.given: no book exists with the provided ID
scenarios.when: the librarian requests deletion of that book
scenarios.then: the system returns HTTP 404 Not Found
